tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and every neutral plane. Dark: the brief's navy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, 2px rules, borders of answers and inputs, error text/icon/rule. On surface 17.2:1, on blue-tint 14.8:1 (light) / 15.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: ADDED. Secondary text (hints, captions, chart footnotes, tags) on surface and blue-tint: 8.4:1 / 7.2:1 light, 9.6:1 / 8.3:1 dark. Use this, not muted, for anything people must read.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected answer fill, links, chart bars, stance-block plane. As text on surface 9.7:1 (light) / 8.1:1 (dark); on blue-tint 8.3:1 / 7.2:1. Means 'selected' or 'act', never 'correct'.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill of the primary button only.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill (selected answer, primary button, stance block). 9.7:1 light / 8.1:1 dark — dark mode puts navy text on the lightened blue.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The single accent: slogan, one key number, share images. At most ONE red element per screen; never on answers, never for errors. Light 5.2:1 on surface = AAA only for large text, so red text must be >=24px, or bold >=19px. Dark 8.3:1.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Expanded explanations, stats backgrounds, hover on neutral controls, chart tracks. Dark tint is close to surface (1.1:1): give a dark tint plane a rule-soft edge.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled options and controls only (text + border). 5.8:1 light / 5.6:1 dark — below AAA by design: disabled is exempt. Not for secondary text: use ink-secondary.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: ADDED. 1px hairlines between list rows, empty progress segments, and the disabled hatch. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: ADDED. Diagonal 135° hatch on disabled options, disabled buttons and the sample banner (2px line, 10px pitch).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: ADDED. Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset. Inside blue planes (stance block, selected answer) it switches to on-blue.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: ADDED. Flat plane behind the bottom sheet. No blur.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: ADDED. Poster plane for the hero, the signature screen and share images; the same navy in both themes.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: ADDED. Text on night (17.2:1).

tokens.name: flag-edge
tokens.usage: ADDED. The 1px outline drawn OUTSIDE every flag so its 3:2 shape survives on white and on navy. On a night plane it switches to on-night.

tokens.name: flag-blue
tokens.usage: Flag wedge only. Official tone in both themes; the flag is never recoloured.

tokens.name: flag-red
tokens.usage: Flag lower stripe only. Counts as the screen's one red element.

tokens.name: flag-white
tokens.usage: Flag upper stripe. Never left to merge with the page: the flag always carries its flag-edge outline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Homepage hero question, signature confirmation. Wide 800. 360px fits ~13 characters per line.
styles.sample: Jak by se měla platit veřejnoprávní média?

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Quiz question, screen titles. One per screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, stance sentence, sheet title.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: UPPERCASE labels above headings and inside callouts.

styles.name: display-desktop
styles.sample: Jak by se měla platit veřejnoprávní média?

styles.name: h1-desktop
styles.usage: Quiz question and screen titles at >=1024px.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Kolik peněz ročně má ČT a ČRo dostat?

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Příliš žluťoučký kůň úpěl ďábelské ódy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, chart footnotes. The floor: nothing smaller except the 13px kicker in caps.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: One key number per screen (may be the screen's red element). Tabular figures (tnum).

styles.name: stat-l
styles.usage: Slider value, big counts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat-m
styles.usage: Bar values, small counts. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: 8px base. space-half is the only off-grid step (tight gaps between bars, label to field).

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Gap between bars, label → input, icon → text in tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options; inner padding of tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter, control padding, sticky bar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Section padding top/bottom on mobile; gap heading → first answer.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Stance block top padding; desktop gutter between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter at 1280px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop section separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop hero breathing room.

radius.note: Zero everywhere. Two circles exist: the profile-photo preview and the selection mark (a small flag in a circle).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, card, input, sheet, chip, bar, callout.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: ONLY the profile-photo preview and the selection mark.

borderWidth.note: Rules do the work shadows would do elsewhere.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows (rule-soft colour), tag outline.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Answer options, inputs, buttons, section separators, app bar, sticky bar top.

tokens.name: rule-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; error state border of inputs and answer groups.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top edge, error rule above a message, stance kicker bar.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target, both axes. Icon buttons are exactly this.

tokens.name: answer-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an answer option and list action rows.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and inverse buttons.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text input and select.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App bar.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: Selection mark circle; the 3:2 flag inside is 20 × 13.3px.

tokens.name: flag-min
tokens.usage: Smallest flag height allowed (wordmark). Clear space around any flag = 1/4 of its height.

tokens.name: screen-mobile
tokens.usage: Design width for mobile; layouts must hold from 320px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop content width inside 1280px (48px gutters).

tokens.name: column-main
tokens.usage: Desktop main column (quiz, sign form).

tokens.name: column-side
tokens.usage: Desktop side column (statement preview).

duration.note: Motion runs once and never loops. prefers-reduced-motion: everything jumps to its end state.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Colour change on hover/select.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Scrim fade, toggle knob.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet slide-up.

tokens.name: duration-flag
tokens.usage: Homepage flag: wedge slide-in and stripes, once on load.

tokens.name: duration-unfold
tokens.usage: Signature confirmation unfold, total budget.

tokens.name: easing-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: flag, sheet, unfold.

tokens.name: easing-in
tokens.usage: Sheet closing.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky bottom action bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Scrim and bottom sheet.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Signature unfold overlay.
